results.title: Z.ai’s open-weights GLM-5.2 beats GPT-5.5 on multiple long-horizon coding benchmarks for 1/6th the cost | VentureBeat
results.snippet: On industry-standard third-party benchmark tests, GLM-5.2 performs above most open source flagship models, even DeepSeek v4 and scores near or above its closed-weights rivals, OpenAI's GPT-5.5 and Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.8.
